name: Python notes
install:
set -eu
echo NOTE_INSTALL_START
sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update
sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y python3-tk python3-pip
sudo python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages beautifulsoup4==4.15.0 jieba==0.42.1 lxml==6.1.3 numpy==2.4.4 openpyxl==3.1.5 pandas==3.0.6 wordcloud==1.9.6
python3 -c 'import tkinter, jieba, lxml, bs4, pandas, openpyxl, wordcloud; print("NOTE_INSTALL_OK")'
